issue.title: sase-core-rs floor is 0.26.10 (<0.27.0) but task wire schema v2 shipped in 0.27.0, failing 64 tests in the tasks/task-handler subsystem
issue.description:
Reproduction in workspace sase_16 (host project gh_sase-org__sase) on 2026-08-13 while
running `SASE_CORE_DIR=<workspace-linked-sase-core> just check-full` (unrelated to the
change being landed, a notification-panel feature):

    64 failed, 29736 passed, 10 skipped
    FAILED tests/main/test_task_handler_kill.py (3 tests)
    FAILED tests/main/test_task_handler_list.py (10 tests)
    FAILED tests/main/test_task_handler_run.py (11 tests)
    FAILED tests/main/test_task_handler_show.py (7 tests)
    FAILED tests/test_tasks_facade.py (3 tests)
    FAILED tests/test_tasks_runner.py (13 tests)
    FAILED tests/ace/tui/test_task_mirror.py (6 tests)
    FAILED tests/ace/tui/test_tasks_store_rows.py (5 tests)
    FAILED tests/ace/tui/test_app_title.py::test_on_mount_keeps_initial_title_when_resolver_returns_none

Isolated repro (project venv, fresh temp SASE_HOME per test):

    $ python -m pytest tests/test_tasks_runner.py::test_submit_supervisor_captures_output_and_task_environment -q
    sase.tasks.runner.TaskSubmitError: could not record task: task wire schema
    mismatch: got 2, expected 1
        src/sase/tasks/runner.py:152: in _submit_supervised_task
            raise TaskSubmitError(...) from exc

Root cause: src/sase/tasks/models.py:11 hardcodes
`TASK_WIRE_SCHEMA_VERSION: Final = 1` and models.py:256-259 raises when the
value the sase_core_rs binding reports does not match. pyproject.toml:46 /
uv.lock cap sase-core-rs at `>=0.26.10,<0.27.0`, but the linked sase-core
checkout (up to date with origin/master, not stale -- `git status` there
shows "up to date with 'origin/master'") builds and installs 0.27.0
(confirmed via `python -c "import importlib.metadata as m;
print(m.version('sase-core-rs'))"` => 0.27.0). 0.27.0 ships task wire schema
version 2; the Python-side floor/schema constant was never bumped to match,
so every task-store write (append_task -> _submit_supervised_task) fails
immediately in any environment that resolves the real published 0.27.0
(not just this workspace's linked-repo override).

Same recurring class as sase-h0, sase-hz, sase-jj, sase-ic, sase-d7, sase-cn
(sase-core-rs floor lags a feature that already shipped in the next published
version) -- not workspace drift like the canceled sase-jw, since the linked
checkout here is current with origin/master, and the mismatch reproduces
against the plain installed package version, not a stale build artifact.

Fix likely needs two coordinated parts: raise pyproject.toml's sase-core-rs
floor to >=0.27.0 (or the correct minimum that carries the task schema v2
change), and update src/sase/tasks/models.py's TASK_WIRE_SCHEMA_VERSION
(and any schema-version handling around it) to accept/produce schema 2.

Verified as unrelated to the notification_read_current_tab plan being
implemented alongside this: the failing files are entirely in the
tasks/task-handler/task-mirror subsystem, none touch notifications, and the
focused notification test suite (69 tests across
tests/notification_store/test_state_updates.py,
tests/test_core_facade/test_notification_store.py,
tests/test_notification_modal_action_bindings.py,
tests/test_notification_modal_mark_and_tabs.py,
tests/test_notification_modal_read_tab.py) plus the 13
notification-touching PNG visual snapshots all pass.
